decision.rationale: I recommend declining. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 10 days after the posting on 2026-10-20. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The card has two postings of 4407 EUR minor units at FERNHILL APOTHECARY (MER-000067), and both posted on 2026-10-20. TXN-008099 was made at 16:31:45Z on 2026-10-19 under AUTH-008289. The disputed TXN-008100 was made at 20:31:45Z the same day under AUTH-008290. The two postings do not share an authorisation. Each has its own approved contactless authorisation, made four hours apart, and neither is flagged for fraud. No refund at this merchant appears on the card. Under duplicate-separate-authorisations, two postings with their own authorisations made some time apart are two purchases, even when the merchant and amount are the same. So the records do not show one charge posted twice.

proposed_actions.reason: Our records show two separate purchases at FERNHILL APOTHECARY on 2026-10-19, each for 44.07 EUR and each approved on its own, about four hours apart (16:31 and 20:31 UTC). This is not one purchase charged twice, so we are closing the dispute.
